down_flag.description: Reverse slice indexing (default is: slices were acquired bottom-up)
down_flag.title: Reverse slice indexing

tr_value.description: Specify TR of data - default is 3s
tr_value.title: TR value

direction.description: Direction of slice acquisition (x=1,y=2,z=3) - default is z
direction.title: Acquisition direction

tcustom_file.description: Filename of single-column slice timings, in fractions of TR, +ve values shift slices forward in time
tcustom_file.title: Custom slice timings file

tglobal_value.description: Global shift in fraction of TR, (default is 0)
tglobal_value.title: Global shift in TR fraction

ocustom_file.description: Filename of single-column custom interleave order file (first slice is referred to as 1 not 0)
ocustom_file.title: Custom interleave order file
